decisions.slots: the payload holds the one graph slot, asserted from the embedded payload
decisions.mounting: the mounted view is the graph, asserted on the studio's own mount() call
decisions.refusal: unknown view values are refused rather than answered as the graph
decisions.selfDescribing: every renderer document declares data-bb-view on its <html>, and the studio reads that (not the tab)
decisions.panels: no rule hides #hud/#legend; the census expression is the count itself, not `.length` of a count
decisions.regions: nodes are grouped by their DIRECTORY (a directory of fewer than three symbols folds into its parent), anchored per region, and drawn as named pods; the Modules filter reads the same grouping, and the nodes carry it
decisions.edges: an aggregate picture draws the heaviest edges up to a zoom-dependent cap and says so, and an edge's alpha falls off with its on-screen span
decisions.layouts: the graph has TWO arrangements — the directory map and the plain force graph — the document declares which one it draws (data-bb-layout, read back by the renderer), both are published with what each draws, the reply names the one it will draw, and switching restarts the simulation instead of reusing the other layout's positions
decisions.panel: collapsing the picked-item box hides it and KEEPS the selection (clearing is the X's job alone), the box docks to either side by control or by dragging its heading, and a collapsed box still names what it is hiding

limitations: No DOM/browser dependency exists in this repository, so the studio is asserted structurally HERE; the pixels and the interactions are now a gate of their own — script/m13/verify-visualize-browser.ts (M13.64 / V10), run as `npm run verify:viz-browser`, which drives the artifact over CDP in a real chromium without adding a browser dependency to this repository.

Interaction (drag, hover, tab switching) is not exercised by THIS file; the layout switch, the collapse/dock behaviour and the drag belong to V10 (script/m13/verify-visualize-browser.ts), and the screenshots that show them are in validation/m13/results/viz-layout-panel.
